component.name: HiveMind
component.summary: Chat with your AI agent hive

description.p: HiveMind is the native client for a hive-server: persistent, chat-addressable AI agents sandboxed in containers. Roster with live state, threads with markdown + attachments, approval queue for privileged actions, exec-log audit trail, embedded agent screens (noVNC), scheduled routines, and a shared skills library.
